plan_description: Builds the reviewable plan (what will run, what stays out and the requirements without coverage) without installing, running or changing anything.
plan_option_profile: Profile used in this plan (default: selection.profile of jgates.yml).
plan_option_scope: Requested scope: changed, full or paths (default: full).
plan_option_path: Path analyzed with --scope paths; can be repeated.
plan_option_head: Commit to analyze (Git reference): the plan reads the configuration of that commit in a snapshot in the data folder, without a checkout in the working tree. Works with any scope.
plan_option_skip: Switches a selector off in this plan only (capability:unit, tool:<instance>...); can be repeated or comma-separated.
plan_option_only: Runs only what the selector reaches, in this plan; can be repeated or comma-separated.
plan_option_template: Forces a manual-activation template in this plan only; can be repeated.
plan_option_no_interactive: No questions (plan never asks; accepted for non-interactive flows).
plan_option_out: Writes the plan to this file, besides the JGates data folder.
plan_bad_cwd: The folder {path} does not exist or is not a folder.
plan_out_failed: Could not write the plan to {path}: {detail}.
plan_out_failed_fix: Check that the --out folder exists and accepts writing.
plan_bad_scope_fix: Use --scope with one of these values: {allowed}.
plan_paths_required_fix: Pass the paths with --path <path> (can be repeated).
plan_paths_not_allowed: --path only applies with --scope paths (the requested scope is {scope}).
plan_paths_not_allowed_fix: Use --scope paths together with --path, or remove --path.
plan_refs_not_allowed: --base only applies with --scope changed (the requested scope is {scope}).
plan_refs_not_allowed_fix: Use --scope changed together with --base, or remove the base reference.
plan_resolve_failed: The project configuration could not be resolved.
plan_only_locked: --only would leave out {item}, which the policy locks at {lock}: {reason}.
plan_only_locked_fix: Include {lock} in --only or remove --only; a locked requirement does not leave the plan.
plan_reason_not_selected: No selector turns this check on.
plan_reason_no_adapter: The tool {tool} is on ({where}), but has no executable adapter in this version of JGates.
plan_python_missing: No Python found for the bridge ({python}); the stage would have no way to run.
plan_sidecar_missing: The quality sidecar package was not found; the stage would have no way to run.
plan_uncovered_no_check: No executable check covers {selector} in this version.
plan_uncovered_for_run: {selector} was left without a check because it was switched off for this run only ({by}).
plan_uncovered_evidence_missing: {selector} was left without coverage: the generic command that declares it has no verifiable evidence contract ({detail}).
plan_uncovered_checks_disabled: The checks that would cover {selector} are switched off ({by}).
plan_template_incompatible: The template {template} ({source}) was forced ({activation}), but no component is compatible with {match}. Components: {components}.
plan_runs_anyway: In {mode} mode the bridge also runs {subchecks}, which are switched off: their result is ignored, but the effects (network, time) happen.
plan_scope_widened: The bridge analyzes the whole workspace: the scope {scope} is recorded and the effective analysis is full.
plan_blocker_bridge_config_outside_works: The configuration file {file} of {subcheck} (configFiles.{subcheck} of the bridge in .jgates/tools.yml) is outside the workspace root, and the bridge only accepts files inside it. Move the file into the workspace or remove the binding.
plan_blocker_bridge_config_missing: The configuration file {file} of {subcheck} (configFiles.{subcheck} of the bridge in .jgates/tools.yml) does not exist. Create the file or remove the binding; the package file only applies without a binding.
plan_blocker_bridge_config_not_file: The binding configFiles.{subcheck} of the bridge points to {file}, which is not a file. Point it to the configuration file of {subcheck}.
plan_blocker_config_invalid: The file {file} has a syntax error and is read by {tools}: {message} Fix the file (or use the draft, without saving) and build the plan again.
plan_blocker_uncovered: {count} requirement(s) without an executable check: {selectors}. The run cannot be approved.
plan_network_denied: The configuration forbids network (execution.network: deny), but {items} need it.
plan_blocked_empty: The plan has no check to run, and {count} selected requirement(s) were left without coverage. An empty plan is never approvable.
plan_blocked_nothing: The plan has no check to run. An empty plan is never approvable.
plan_blocked_fix: Turn on, in the profile or in the project, an executable check for each requirement, or remove the --skip and --only of this run.
plan_check_invalid: The file is not a valid JGates plan ({count} problem(s): {detail}).
plan_check_invalid_fix: Generate a new plan with jgates plan --out <file>.
plan_check_hash: The plan hash does not match the content: the plan was changed after being generated.
plan_check_hash_fix: Generate a new plan with jgates plan; a hand-edited plan is never run.
plan_check_workspace: The plan is from another folder ({detail}).
plan_check_workspace_fix: Generate the plan in the project itself with jgates plan --cwd <project>.
plan_check_stale: The configuration, the templates, the discovery or the versions changed since the plan ({detail}).
plan_check_stale_fix: Review and generate a new plan with jgates plan.
plan_check_tampered: The plan content is not what the current configuration produces ({detail}): the plan was changed.
plan_check_tampered_fix: Generate a new plan with jgates plan; a command edited in the JSON is never run.
plan_text_changes: Changed since the previous plan: {added} new item(s), {removed} removed, {changed} changed, {files} configuration file(s).
plan_text_reduced: Selection reduced for this run only: the approval does not count as approval of the full profile.
plan_text_not_approvable: This plan cannot produce an approval: {reasons}
plan_not_a_git_repository: --base and --head need a Git repository, and the workspace folder is not in one.
plan_not_a_git_repository_fix: Run from a folder inside the repository, or remove --base and --head.
plan_git_unavailable: git was not found, and --base and --head need it.
plan_git_unavailable_fix: Put git on the PATH or give the executable in JGATES_GIT.
plan_ref_unknown: The reference {ref} does not name a commit of this repository.
plan_ref_unknown_fix: Check the name or the SHA (git log) and fetch the commit if it is only on the remote.
plan_snapshot_failed: Could not build the snapshot of commit {commit}: {detail}
plan_snapshot_failed_fix: Check that the workspace folder exists in that commit and that git works in this repository.
